gates.title: Gate catalog integrity
gates.summary: Keeps the registry, matrix, gate docs, task actions, and workflow bindings consistent.

gates.title: DCO sign-off
gates.summary: Rejects pull-request commits without a valid Signed-off-by trailer.

gates.title: ADR delivery admissibility
gates.summary: Checks the applicable ADR delivery and promotion declaration.

gates.title: Buildchain lifecycle configuration
gates.summary: Validates version state and required lifecycle declarations.

gates.title: Promotion contract rehearsal
gates.summary: Rehearses alpha and stable promotion admission without publishing.

gates.title: Build-free source acceptance
gates.summary: Runs the immutable dev source gate without compiler or release lifecycles.

gates.title: Changed-scope developer check
gates.summary: Checks changed source plus shared contract and tooling tests.

gates.title: Whole-tree developer check
gates.summary: Runs repository-wide lint, format, Rust, contract, docs, SDK, and tooling checks.

gates.title: Documentation structure and contracts
gates.summary: Checks Markdown, links, metadata, ADR projections, examples, and toolchain pins.

gates.title: Required documentation prose policy
gates.summary: Applies qualified objective prose rules that block pull requests.

gates.title: External documentation links
gates.summary: Checks remote URLs separately from deterministic source acceptance.

gates.title: Shifu workspace matrix
gates.summary: Formats, lints, tests, release-builds, and smokes Shifu on three hosted OSes.

gates.title: Product distribution build
gates.summary: Builds the native Kungfu distribution and release artifact tree.

gates.title: Full product verification
gates.summary: Rebuilds Core, freezes product, verifies runtime, slices, fixtures, and Episode smoke.

gates.title: Release verification with memory safety
gates.summary: Verifies release artifacts and runs sanitizer corpus replay plus bounded fuzzing.

gates.title: Release artifact admission
gates.summary: Requires build status, three platform artifacts, release passport, and KFD witnesses.

gates.title: Layer qualification contract
gates.summary: Checks Core, SDK, product independence, and registered source surfaces.

gates.title: Episode qualification smoke
gates.summary: Runs mvp-smoke-v1 and verifies required semantic dimensions.

gates.title: Episode release evidence
gates.summary: Produces the self-contained Episode release evidence envelope.

gates.title: Embedding membrane qualification
gates.summary: Builds and runs language, storage, and libwasm membrane consumers.

gates.title: mmap native contract tests
gates.summary: Runs yijinjing mmap and content-hash native contract binaries.

gates.title: mmap performance qualification
gates.summary: Builds the evidence target and records bounded mmap measurements.

gates.title: Durability contract tests
gates.summary: Runs native and Python durability contracts against built Core artifacts.

gates.title: State service contract tests
gates.summary: Builds and runs state-service native and binding contracts.

gates.title: KFX Profile Suite contracts
gates.summary: Runs Node and Python Profile Suite contract fixtures.

gates.title: Profile lifecycle native tests
gates.summary: Builds and runs the Profile lifecycle native contract target.

gates.title: Agent Profile SDK tests
gates.summary: Runs installed Python Agent Profile SDK and composition tests.

gates.title: Profile KFD-3 qualification
gates.summary: Qualifies the Profile-level KFD-3 capability and evidence surface.

gates.title: Durable ingest tests
gates.summary: Builds and runs the durable-ingest native contract target.

gates.title: Projection bootstrap tests
gates.summary: Builds and runs projection bootstrap recovery contracts.

gates.title: Crash recovery tests
gates.summary: Builds and runs restart, repair, and crash-recovery contracts.

gates.title: Runtime error contract tests
gates.summary: Runs native and Python runtime error contracts.

gates.title: C++ modules qualification
gates.summary: Measures and verifies compiler module and header fallback contracts.

gates.title: libwasm Cargo cache qualification
gates.summary: Builds libwasm adapters twice and verifies cache reuse and equivalence.
